item.title: New Balance's Chocolate Dad Shoe Belongs In a Bakery
item.description: New Balance's supple T500 tennis shoe is double-dunked in dark chocolate. Just another gem from the NB bakery.

item.title: After Years of Military-Coded New Balances, WTAPS Devised a Pared-Back Beauty
item.description: Just when you think you have WTAPS and New Balance’s sneakers all figured out, the Japanese fashion label springs up with a brilliantly blacked-out 1300 shoe.

item.title: At a Rare Art Show, the Elusive Martin Margiela Gets a Little Less Anonymous
item.description: Famously taciturn fashion designer turned artist Martin Margiela has quietly announced a new art show. And he's provided some commentary on what to expect!

item.title: Vans' Vibram-Soled Skate Shoe Has the (Hot) Sauce
item.description: Vans OTW piped-up its spicy Authentic 44 sneaker with a fire red upper. One thing about a Vans' shredder, its going to bring the heat.
